For Foodex, we will present our flagship product, Khustai Gouda, the oldest and premier Mongolian cheese, made continuously for 30 years in the Khustai National Park. Produced by Tumurkhuyag Urtnasan and his family since 1995, it comes from a remote, nomadic area 80 km southwest of Ulaanbaatar. Khustai Gouda is unique for several reasons. The milk used comes from cows grazing on wild forbs in high-altitude pastures. This summer milk is rich in proteins and minerals, giving the cheese its distinctive flavor. Handmade in small batches, the cheese is salted and aged for 2-3 months in a wooden shed before further maturation near Ulaanbaatar. Some batches age up to 18 months, resulting in a firm, crumbly texture and a flavor that evolves from mild and slightly salty to rich, nutty, and caramelized with umami notes. Unlike industrial Gouda, it contains no preservatives or additives, reflecting the pure taste of Mongolian milk. Khustai Gouda stands out for its exceptional quality and pairs well with wine, enhancing dishes like fondue and pasta.
